dishes.make_ahead: Cut the dough rounds up to 2 hours ahead and keep them covered in the fridge; top and bake just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C with a tray inside.
Roll out the dough on a bench dusted with the plain flour and cut into rounds.
Spread each round with sauce, then add mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.
Bake on the hot tray until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the dough rounds up to 2 hours ahead and keep them covered in the fridge; top and bake just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C with a tray inside.
Roll out the dough on a bench dusted with the plain flour and cut into rounds.
Spread each round with sauce, then add mozzarella and a slice of plant-based pepperoni.
Bake on the hot tray until the bases are crisp and the cheese bubbles.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 3 days ahead and store airtight; pipe the pug faces on the day

steps.text: Brown the butter in a pan and leave to cool.
Beat the cooled butter with the sugar and egg, then mix in the flour and bicarbonate of soda.
Roll into balls and place on lined trays.
Bake at 180C until set.
Cool the cookies on a rack.
Melt the chocolate and pipe pug faces on each cookie.

dishes.make_ahead: Roll and cut up to a day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; brush with egg and bake to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C and line two trays.
Mix the pork, onion, fennel seeds, breadcrumbs, 1 egg and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Cut each pastry sheet in half. Lay a log of filling along each half, roll up and press the seam down underneath.
Cut each roll into 4, brush with the other egg, beaten, and bake for 25 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve hot with tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Roll and cut up to a day ahead and keep covered in the fridge

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C and line two trays. Fry the mushrooms and onion in a little oil until dry, then cool.
Mash the lentils roughly and mix with the mushrooms, fennel seeds, breadcrumbs, 1 egg and a good pinch of salt and pepper.
Cut each pastry sheet in half. Lay a log of filling along each half, roll up and press the seam down underneath.
Cut each roll into 4, brush with the other egg, beaten, and bake for 25 minutes until golden.
Serve hot with tomato sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Keep the dough in the fridge up to 2 days ahead and crumble the sausage meat up to 1 day ahead; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Stretch the dough thin into two bases and spread with the crushed tomato, seasoned with salt.
Top with mozzarella and crumbled sausage meat, skins removed.
Bake each pizza at max heat until the crust blisters.

veg.make_ahead: Fry and crumble the vegetarian sausages up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Slice the vegetarian sausages and fry in the oil with the fennel seeds until browned, then crumble.
Stretch the dough thin into two bases and spread with the crushed tomato, seasoned with salt.
Top with mozzarella and the crumbled sausage.
Bake each pizza at max heat until the crust blisters.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the icing up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered; dip the doughnuts on the day so the glaze stays fresh

steps.text: Mix the icing sugar, espresso and melted butter until smooth.
Dip the top of each doughnut in the icing.
Leave to set.

dishes.make_ahead: Brew and cool the espresso up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; blend and whip the cream to order

steps.text: Brew the espressos and cool.
Blend with the ice cream, milk and some of the caramel until thick and smooth.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Pour into tall glasses, top with cream, drizzle with caramel and hang gummy worms over each rim.
